clue.text: The Beetle Cafe unusually chock-full ? Right

indicators.note: unusually says these letters appear in an out-of-the-ordinary order

parts.note: the clue's chock-full offers its first part, chock, as the letters to mix

explanation.surface: A café called The Beetle is packed to the rafters, which is all to the good.
explanation.walkthrough: 'unusually' rearranges CAFE plus CHOCK; R for 'Right' is added at the end. Only the 'chock' part of 'chock-full' is fodder; 'full' just completes the familiar phrase.
explanation.definitionFit: This is a large European flying insect, also called the maybug, one kind of beetle.

clue.text: Island needs grain for the goat

indicators.note: the island needs some grain to become the goat, so the goat is the grain-less island plus grain: take the grain away

parts.note: Capricorn is the zodiac sign of the goat
corn is grain

explanation.surface: Someone on an island has to find feed for the goat.
explanation.walkthrough: Read backwards: the island needs CORN to make the goat CAPRICORN, so CAPRICORN without CORN leaves the island.
explanation.definitionFit: Capri is an island in the Bay of Naples, off southern Italy.

clue.text: Study a French instrument.A puzzling thing

parts.note: to con is an old word for to study or learn
un is French for a
a drum is a musical instrument

explanation.surface: Someone studies a French musical instrument and finds it baffling.
explanation.definitionFit: A riddle or puzzle is something that baffles, a hard question.

clue.text: Runners v instrumental , players?

parts.note: v stands for versus, which in Latin is contra, against
bandists are players in an instrumental band

explanation.surface: A match is set up between athletes and musicians in a band.
explanation.walkthrough: Runners here are smugglers, people who run goods illegally, not athletes.
explanation.definitionFit: Smugglers are said to run contraband goods, so runners are smugglers.

clue.text: An emperor ? I'd say a weather-prophet

parts.note: an is the form of the article a, used here as the single letter
Nero was a Roman emperor
taken as written without the apostrophe

explanation.surface: An emperor is hailed as a forecaster of the weather.
explanation.definitionFit: This kind of barometer measures air pressure without liquid and so foretells weather changes.

clue.text: Morton was one formerly on the stage

parts.note: ex means former, once was
an actor is someone who works on the stage

explanation.surface: A man named Morton used to be a stage performer.
explanation.walkthrough: John Morton, Henry VII's minister, was famous for squeezing taxes from everyone ('Morton's Fork'): he was one who demanded payment.
explanation.definitionFit: Morton extracted tax money, and someone who demands payment by force is a collector of that kind.

clue.text: A great autocrat, was Dr Johnson

definitions.meaning: an old spelling of khan, an Asian ruler
Samuel Johnson was nicknamed the Great ... of literature by Smollett

explanation.definitionFit: An old form of khan, a ruler of absolute power, and the nickname Smollett gave Samuel Johnson as dictator of letters.

clue.text: When natives conceal dye

indicators.note: conceal says the letters sit hidden within the words when natives

explanation.surface: At times local people hide a colouring agent.
explanation.definitionFit: This reddish plant extract is used to colour hair and skin.

clue.text: Mercurial errand-boy ?

parts.note: Mercury was the Roman god who carried the other gods' messages, so his kind of errand-boy is a courier

explanation.definitionFit: Someone who carries messages or runs errands; Mercury was the gods' herald.

clue.text: Thirty-second note from the staff

parts.note: the staff is the musical stave, and this is a note lasting one thirty-second of a whole note

explanation.definitionFit: In music this note is half a semiquaver, a thirty-second of a semibreve.

clue.text: Mortification of writer, having broken cane

parts.note: a pen is something you write with

indicators.note: broken says the word cane is smashed and its letters rearranged

explanation.surface: A writer is humiliated after snapping a cane.
explanation.definitionFit: Mortification is self-punishment for sin, which is doing atonement.

clue.text: Entry, though hellish, is easy

parts.note: Virgil wrote facilis descensus Averno: the descent to the underworld lake is easy

explanation.definitionFit: This lake near Naples was thought to be the entrance to the underworld, and Virgil said the way down is easy.

clue.text: Miners not distressed in these bowels of the earth

definitions.note: the deepest parts are as far in as one can get

indicators.note: distressed says the words miners not are knocked out of shape

explanation.surface: Miners are calm even deep underground.
explanation.definitionFit: The bowels of the earth are its deepest recesses, the furthest in.

clue.text: Senseless, in one north of the Border

parts.note: ane is the Scots word for one; the Border is England's border with Scotland

explanation.surface: Someone in Scotland is behaving without sense.
explanation.walkthrough: 'North of the Border' means in Scotland, where ane is one.
explanation.definitionFit: Senseless and silly mean empty-headed.

clue.text: Aboriginal person writes first letter in bed

indicators.note: in places the letter inside the word for bed

parts.note: a crib is a child's bed
A is the first letter of the alphabet

explanation.surface: A person writes the letter A while lying in bed.
explanation.definitionFit: The Caribs were an original people of the Lesser Antilles and South America.

clue.text: A chapel, it could be, in Haroun-al-Raschid's empire

indicators.note: could be says these letters could be rearranged into something else

explanation.surface: A chapel might be found in the realm of a famous Baghdad ruler.
explanation.walkthrough: 'could be' rearranges A CHAPEL IT. Harun al-Rashid was the caliph of the Arabian Nights.
explanation.definitionFit: Harun al-Rashid was caliph of Baghdad, so his realm was a caliph's domain.

clue.text: Boy in challenging situation, becoming gloomy

indicators.note: in puts the boy inside the word for challenging

parts.note: daring means bold and challenging
Ken is a boy's name

explanation.surface: A lad in a tricky spot is turning moody.
explanation.definitionFit: Growing dark or gloomy, like the sky at dusk.

clue.text: Meaning to provide fashionable nursing

parts.note: in means fashionable
tending means nursing, caring for

explanation.surface: Someone plans to offer stylish care.
explanation.definitionFit: Meaning to do something is planning or having it in mind.

clue.text: Maned, with tail twisted, and having thin plates

indicators.note: twisted says the letters of maned and tail are wrung into a new order

explanation.surface: A horse with a mane and a twisted tail is armoured with plates.
explanation.definitionFit: Made of thin layers or sheets pressed together, as plates.

clue.text: Beer cask is one article in N. Africa

definitions.note: a country of North Africa, standing for the region

parts.note: a tun is a large cask for beer or wine
I is the Roman numeral for one
a is the indefinite article

explanation.surface: A barrel of beer is found to be a single item in North Africa.
explanation.definitionFit: This country lies on the north African coast between Algeria and Libya.

clue.text: Much of the lexicon in 12 manner of speaking

indicators.note: much of says most of the word is kept and only its end dropped

parts.note: a lexicon is a dictionary

explanation.surface: A good part of a word-list sets out a way of talking.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Much of' leaves DICTIONARY without its last three letters. 'in 12' links to clue 12.
explanation.definitionFit: Diction is the choice of words and style of enunciation in speech.

clue.text: Finally put under for season out west

indicators.note: out says the letter for west is taken away

parts.note: winter is a season

explanation.surface: Someone is at last anaesthetised for the season in the west.
explanation.definitionFit: To bury a body is finally to put it under the ground.

clue.text: What's so good about a teetotal singer?

indicators.note: about places the pious word around the other pieces

parts.note: pi, short for pious, is crossword slang for very good

explanation.surface: Someone asks what is so virtuous about a singer who never drinks.
explanation.walkthrough: Adelina Patti was a famous 19th-century opera soprano.
explanation.definitionFit: Adelina Patti was a celebrated Victorian soprano.

clue.text: Army volunteers express disapproval ? It's forbidden

parts.note: TA is the Territorial Army, Britain's volunteer reserve
boo is a shout of disapproval

explanation.surface: Volunteer soldiers jeer at something they are not allowed.
explanation.definitionFit: Something banned by social custom is prohibited.

clue.text: Criticize acts, we hear, Or scenes at night

indicators.note: we hear says the words are to be taken as they sound when spoken

parts.note: knock means criticise and turns are acts on stage

explanation.surface: Critics pan the music-hall acts, or night-time scenes.
explanation.walkthrough: KNOCK (criticise) plus TURNS (acts) is heard as the word meaning night pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: A nocturne is a painting of a night scene, or a dreamy night piece of music.

clue.text: Extract metal from a fish

definitions.meaning: to heat ore to get the metal out

explanation.definitionFit: To heat ore to release its metal, and a small silvery sea and freshwater fish.

clue.text: A conspirator turning his head in the shrubbery?

indicators.note: turning his head says the leading letter of the plotter's name is shifted out of first place

parts.note: Brutus was one of the conspirators who killed Julius Caesar

explanation.surface: A plotter turns his head while hiding among bushes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turning his head' moves the B of BRUTUS back one place, giving RBUTUS.
explanation.definitionFit: The strawberry tree is an evergreen shrub of the heath family.

clue.text: Delivery note for pub singer, say?

definitions.text: Delivery note for pub singer, say?

parts.words: Delivery note for pub singer, say?
parts.note: a bill sent with goods; split in two, a pub singer is said to be in good voice, and delivery and note are singer's words too

explanation.definitionFit: A bill listing goods sent, a delivery note; a singer in good form is 'in voice'.

clue.text: Back to the old islet

indicators.note: back says the pieces are read in reverse

parts.note: ye is an old form of the

explanation.surface: Someone returns to the old island.
explanation.definitionFit: A small river island, especially in the Thames.

clue.text: East Lynne surgeon's vehicle manufacturer

definitions.meaning: The surgeon in Mrs Henry Wood's novel East Lynne
a wright who builds wains, or farm carts

explanation.definitionFit: The doctor in Mrs Henry Wood's Victorian melodrama, and a maker of carts or wagons.
